profile.name: Thermo Fisher ATC 热循环仪
profile.description: 这是一种用于PCR等核酸扩增流程的热循环仪，通过程序化温度循环对样品进行变性、退火和延伸处理。设备带有可开合上盖，用于在实验运行前后装载或取出反应板/管。
profile.description_en: This is a thermocycler used for PCR and related nucleic acid amplification workflows. It performs programmed temperature cycling for denaturation, annealing, and extension, and includes an opening lid for loading and unloading reaction plates or tubes.

registry.name: Automated Thermal Cycler PCR仪
registry.description: Automated Thermal Cycler PCR仪是由Opentrons生产的普通PCR仪，主要功能包括关闭、打开。支持Signal, Slot等操作。
